descricao_original: A high magnification electron micrograph shows portions of four myofibrils. This banding pattern and the changes that occur during contraction are the same as those for skeletal muscle fibers. Note the precise alignment of the sarcomeres. 40,000x

marcadores.explicacao_original: Thick myofilaments (red arrows) are broader than thin myofilaments and, therefore, are easier to identify. The thin myofilaments are difficult to resolve in this preparation, but are located in the I band (blue arrows) and extend between the thick myofilaments in the A band.
